palette.notes: Code: 12 colours, one ramp of 12 with only 8.5 deg hue shift; nearly monochrome teal/cyan with tiny red, amber and green traffic lights as accents.

lighting: Night, street lamp glow at top left; snow catches the cyan light. The only warm/saturated points are the traffic signals and a small orange sign.
silhouette: No characters; tall poles and the dark tower block give vertical silhouettes in the 9:16 frame.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 83.3 ms (2.5s, about 12 drawings/s), 13.29 changes/s from falling snow. Traffic light cycles red, amber, green, amber, red, about 10 s per loop on the sheet.

texture: Posterised, photo-like scene (may be a photo converted to pixels rather than hand-drawn); light dither (0.002) in the snow and sky.
camera: Locked vertical frame, no moves; built for a seamless loop.

acting.acts: The traffic light is the 'actor': its colour change is the only event, on a slow timer.
acting.depth: Snowbank foreground, intersection mid-ground, tower block behind; atmospheric haze lightens the background.

techniques: near-monochrome teal ramp with tiny saturated accents
one slow state change (traffic light) as the scene's event
seamless loop length matched to the light cycle
feel: single teal ramp + snow loop + traffic light as the only colour change = quiet hypnotic winter loop
for_fred: Keep one small colour event on a slow cycle (a lamp, a sign) in Fred's background so the frame lives while he is off-screen; let him re-enter when the light changes.
